title: Polynomial bound on example budget
statement: Let $n\ge1$, let $t>0$ be rational, let $0<\varepsilon\le\tfrac12$ be rational, and let $C,Q$ be nonnegative integers. Suppose $\varepsilon\ge 1/(Q+1)$ and $t\le(C+1)\bigl(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1\bigr)$. Then the monotone bounded-influence random-example budget is at most $K(C,Q)(n+1)^{E(C,Q)}$, where $K(C,Q)$ and $E(C,Q)$ are the specified random-example constant and exponent.
